title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Agreement — Early Termination Fee Proration
content:
## Charge

An early termination is charged once, when the termination notice is recorded, pointing to the notice request, at the early termination fee figured as follows for a notice given while term months remain, and never for a notice given with none remaining, rather than at the package's flat early termination fee when the program terminates before the package's minimum term from signing; a reinstatement is charged at the reinstatement fee its own charge sets; a late batch, a returned funding payment, a corrected load file and a load reversal request are each charged once, pointing to the entry or request that incurred them, as the base rule provides.

## Proration

**Term months remaining.** The term months remaining of a Paystride Payroll Card Program are the package's minimum term in months less the term months served, never below zero, the term months served being the whole months from the program's signed date to today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

**Fee.** The early termination fee is the package's early termination fee multiplied by the term months remaining and divided by the package's minimum term in months, rounded half up to the cent, and a notice given with no term months remaining carries no early termination fee.

**Order of the figures.** The date the term months are served from is settled first, the multipliers of the prorated fee are applied next, and amounts added to the fee are added to that result last, before the rounding; a notice given with no term months remaining carries none of them.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Package (fee; minimum term) | Signed | Today | Term months served | Remaining | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advantage (1000.00; 24 months) | 14 March, year one | 9 November, year two | 19 | 5 | 1000.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by 24, that is 208.33 |
| Standard (250.00; 12 months) | 2 February | 2 December, same year | 10 | 2 | 250.00 multiplied by 2 and divided by 12, that is 41.67 |
| Select (500.00; 12 months) | 6 May, year one | 6 June, year two | 13 | 0 | none |
